title: Fix Key Metrics win rate percent scale
body: ## Summary Key Metrics win rate was `(wins / trades) * 10`, so the displayed percent was one tenth of the real rate. A buy at $100,000 followed by a sell at $110,000 is 1 winning step out of 2 trades: that showed `5.0%` and now shows `50.0%`. A perfect record showed `10.0%` and now shows `100.0%`. A win is still a trade whose portfolio P&L increased. With one trade the card still reports `0.0%` (and zero best/worst), which is the same threshold as before. With no trades, Win Rate is `N/A` instead of `0.0%`. ## Verification Seeded account `metrics@example.com`: buy 0.01 BTC at $100,000, sell 0.01 BTC at $110,000. Lifetime P&L is $100. ![Key Metrics before the fix, win rate 5.0%](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-a4a34bb8-395d-40fb-9654-57b9aeb32665) ![Key Metrics after the fix, win rate 50.0%](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-22a77c73-d4d1-4337-89bf-685958f39697) Empty history shows `N/A`. A single buy still shows `0.0%`. ![Key Metrics with no trades, win rate N/A](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-049d0ab4-3a1d-4706-a14c-8fe0b5d8d78b) ![Key Metrics with one buy, win rate 0.0%](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-8acb0476-4084-4298-8221-8fabee344b63) Unit tests cover the empty, single-trade, 50%, 100%, and 25% cases.
